source_fields.value: I need help with my account. The app crashes whenever I open settings. I canceled my subscription but was charged afterward.

The Settings crash has been patched in build 7.9.3. Please install build 7.9.3 using your existing installation channel, then reopen Settings to check whether the crash persists. If it still crashes after updating, let us know.
